summary: Preserve adopter concurrency and idle handoff policy during immutable upgrades

delivery.outcome: Preserve target-owned concurrency and idle-handoff policy during immutable standard upgrades without changing new-install defaults or ownership gates.
nonGoals: No consumer adoption, live runtime writes or protected-policy waiver
No transfer of foreign ownership or timeout-only takeover

architecture.decision: Make upgrade projection target-owned and digest/CAS bound: preserve explicit existing concurrency and idle-handoff policy from the verified accepted base, while retaining published defaults for new targets.
architecture.rollback: Independently reviewed revert preserving immutable prior standard and target policy.

validation.evidence: Real Git upgrade fixtures preserve target-owned policy and retain fresh-target defaults.
Old-base, policy-drift, stale-owner, foreign-owner and CAS regressions fail closed.
Canonical source governance and qualified full tests pass; protected native CI and independent review remain required.
